opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships

amount.raw: The Fellowship is tenable for three years, starting from Autumn 2027 in a UK-based university or higher education institution.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early-career researchers in the humanities or social sciences based at a UK university or research organisation.
opportunities.summary: The British Academy Postdoctoral Fellowships is a three year award made to an annual cohort of outstanding early-career researchers in the humanities or social sciences.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Postdoctoral or equivalent researchers with a current long-term appointment at a UK-based Higher Education Institution or Independent Research Organisation.
opportunities.summary: The Talent Development Awards are available to promote the acquisition and advancement of skills in relevant areas by UK-based researchers, supporting innovative research methods, be that through skills development, collaboration or dissemination.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027

amount.raw: The total funding available per award in this call is up to £300,000 over 2 years.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers from the humanities and social sciences based at a UK university or research institute, with international collaboration.
opportunities.summary: The programme aims to support projects which engage with questions concerning the relationship between expertise, public understanding and policy delivery internationally, and highlight the importance of collaboration between communities of practice, disciplines, capacities and borders.

opportunities.opportunity_id: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27

amount.raw: The Academy is offering up to two one-year fellowships hosted in DGAP's offices in Berlin. These are offered as awards for up to £150,000 for 12 months in duration (with Full Economic Costing at 80 per cent).

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early- and mid-career researchers from across the humanities and social sciences based in the UK.
opportunities.summary: The Global Innovation Fellowships provide opportunities to UK-based early- and mid-career researchers from across the humanities and social sciences to develop their skills, networks and careers in the creative and cultural, public, private and policy sectors to address challenges that require innovative approaches and solutions.
